summary: fix(settings): tune Nova weights and borders on auth pages
description:
Because:
- Manual review found Nova headings and BoxButton labels too heavy and some borders too dark or thick.
- Figma's base buttons are 40px, taller than Acorn's default padding gives.

This commit:
- Uses font-heading for headings that were font-bold (semibold under Nova).
- Gives BoxButton semibold labels and the deemphasized border under Nova.
- Rests choice cards at a 1px border, 2px when checked.
- Gives Nova cta-base-p the large block padding (about 42px tall).
